title: *NSYNC members 'exploring tour' for 30th anniversary - but without key member - NewsBreak
text:
By Connor McCrory ,
1 hours ago Four of the original *NSYNC members are weighing plans for a major comeback that would mark three decades since the group first launched, according to TMZ .
Lance Bass, Joey Fatone, JC Chasez, and Chris Kirkpatrick are in active talks about staging an arena tour in 2026. The plan is moving forward even though Justin Timberlake has reportedly not committed to rejoining them. Promoters believe fan demand remains high enough to support a large-scale run of shows without Timberlake.
Industry offers surfaced last year from Live Nation and AEG for a stadium tour involving all five members, following Bass's push for a reunion in 2024.

Timberlake declined to engage at the time, before later revealing his Lyme disease diagnosis.
While a five-piece reunion would almost certainly command stadium-level interest, proposals are already being drafted for a four-member version.
Hints of a reunion have kept fans buzzing for years. The group made headlines with a surprise performance at the 2023 MTV Video Music Awards, released a new track for the Trolls soundtrack, and walked the film’s premiere carpet together.
The four also appeared with Timberlake at one of his Los Angeles shows and shared the stage at Coachella in 2019 without him.
Adding momentum, *NSYNC’s classic single Bye Bye Bye surged back into global charts in 2024 after featuring prominently in the film Deadpool. That renewed visibility reminded promoters of the group’s enduring draw.
Taking to Instagram to commemorate the group's 30th anniversary, the Instagram wrote, "October 1, 1995 feels like yesterday... and somehow a lifetime ago."
"Five guys chasing a dream turned into something bigger than we ever imagined. The music. The shows. The memories. An unbreakable bond: with each other, and with all of you. Through every high and low, your love has carried us. Forever grateful. Here's to three decades of *NSYNC. Justin, Chris, Joey, Lance & JC"
While Bass, Fatone, Chasez, and Kirkpatrick remain optimistic that Timberlake will join at some point, the working plan is to keep discussions moving regardless.
Taking to X, fans voiced excitement for the potential comeback.
One user wrote, "*NSYNC Exploring Arena Tour Possibilities Amid 30th Anniversary *NSYNC may reunite for a tour despite Justin Timberlake's absence."
"I know I shouldn’t be arguing with people about this topic , BUT THERE IS NO NSYNC TOUR WITHOUT JUSTIN," another added.
A third penned, "I'm concerned because Justin isn't in the picture. It wouldn't be the same without him."
If Timberlake eventually signs on, insiders say the project could expand into full stadium runs with multiple dates per city.
For now, though, the focus is on preparing a package that would allow four of the members to celebrate the 30th anniversary milestone together and bring *NSYNC back to live stages.
